EndpointUrl.title: vCon store endpoint
EndpointUrl.description: Required. HTTPS URL that receives the final vCon (for SipPulse: the CRM's /api/vcons/ingest).

HmacSecret.title: vCon store HMAC secret
HmacSecret.description: The CRM's VCON_HMAC_SECRET. Every delivery is signed with X-MeetVcon-Signature: sha256=<HMAC-SHA256 of the body>.

AllowedEmailDomains.title: Allowed collaborator email domains
AllowedEmailDomains.description: Chrome profile email domains allowed to capture and receive the transcript email. Defaults to sippulse.com.

TranscriptionProvider.title: Live transcription provider
TranscriptionProvider.description: deepgram (nova-3, multilingual, diarized) or sippulse_ai (SipPulse AI streaming gateway, pt-BR). Both speak the /v1/listen protocol. Defaults to deepgram.

TranscriptionUrl.title: Live transcription base URL
TranscriptionUrl.description: HTTPS base of the provider, e.g. https://api.deepgram.com; the WebSocket is <base as wss>/v1/listen.

TranscriptionApiKey.title: Live transcription API key
TranscriptionApiKey.description: Key for the transcription provider (Deepgram: a usage:write key). Readable on every enrolled machine: use a dedicated, rotatable key.

SipPulseAiUrl.title: SipPulse AI base URL (notes)
SipPulseAiUrl.description: HTTPS base of the SipPulse AI API used for live notes and the final report (.../v1/openai/chat/completions), e.g. https://api.sippulse.ai.

SipPulseAiApiKey.title: SipPulse AI API key (notes)
SipPulseAiApiKey.description: Key for the same environment as SipPulseAiUrl. Readable on every enrolled machine: use a dedicated, rotatable key with a spending limit.

TypeSafeUrl.title: TypeSafe base URL
TypeSafeUrl.description: HTTPS base of the TypeSafe API (.../v1/systemone).

TypeSafeApiKey.title: TypeSafe API key (pilot)
TypeSafeApiKey.description: Enables inline per-utterance classification (intent, sentiment, action items) with the Jev model. Readable on every enrolled machine: use a dedicated, rotatable key.

CaptureEnabled.title: Enable meeting capture
CaptureEnabled.description: Optional kill switch. Defaults to enabled.
